name: Maki
description: Maki is a manga collection manager for the *arr ecosystem. It tracks series across multiple scraper sources and torrent trackers, downloads chapters into CBZ files with embedded metadata, and lets you read them with a built-in reader (with a Home screen and progress tracking) or hand them off to Kavita. Includes an OPDS server for external readers, scrobbling to AniList/MyAnimeList/Kitsu/MangaBaka, rewind reading stats, user tags and saved library filters, and a local-embeddings "Discover" recommendation engine over the MangaBaka dump. After starting the container, open the WebUI, go to Settings, and add your /library path as a root folder. Point a Kavita library at the same /library folder to read the downloaded CBZs.
